senses.gloss: (sec. r. of זָנָה) to be faithless, suspected of faithlessness.—Part. pass. זָנוּן, pl. זְנוּנִים of spurious paternity.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 87a:14">Pes. 87ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ותוליד לך בנים ז׳</he> and she will bear thee spurious sons; <cite ref="Pesachim 87b">ib. 87ᵇ</cite> <he>ובניך ז׳</he>; v. <cite ref="G00572"><he>זְנוּנִים</he></cite>.
